goals: Update project documentation (README.md and USAGE.md) to reflect current state
Generate and execute commit for all uncommitted work

tasks.title: Review uncommitted changes and update README.md
Update USAGE.md with current usage instructions
Craft conventional commit message and commit all changes

acceptanceCriteria.statement: README.md accurately describes current project state and recent changes
USAGE.md provides correct, up-to-date usage instructions
Commit message follows conventional commit format and summarizes all changes
All uncommitted work is properly staged and committed
git status shows clean working tree after commit
